name: Exclusive class-granted companion paths
description: Where a base class grants mutually exclusive bonded, persistent or temporary companion paths, select one applicable path; do not automatically grant both. This applies independently of separately authorized companion-granting features.
sorcererAndWizard: Use the class-specific true familiar alternatives and keep their detailed mechanics deferred until shared reconciliation.
independentGrants: A separate explicit class or feat grant may provide another companion. Merely knowing Find Familiar is not an automatic class companion entitlement.
unresolved: The distinct companion mechanical packages, respec/replacement procedures, and effective source timing require the dedicated shared companion pass.
